Subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling

[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Demo Regional Hospital (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 43-year-old female patient with a history of hypertension received their first dose of DemoCardolol (dose: 500mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-01-18.
Approximately 2 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Reyes (fictional reporter)
Demo Regional Hospital
Contact: demo.reporter672@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
